readme:
# Glassdoor Scraper - Reviews, Jobs & Salaries

Scrape company data from [Glassdoor](https://www.glassdoor.com) — the world's largest employer review platform. Extract reviews, ratings, salaries, jobs, interview experiences, and company overviews.

## Features

- **Multi-mode scraping** — Reviews, Jobs, Salaries, Interviews, Overview, Benefits
- **Company ratings** — Overall rating, CEO approval, recommend to friend %
- **Review details** — Pros, cons, job title, employment status, rating breakdown
- **Salary data** — Salary ranges by job title and location
- **Job listings** — Open positions with descriptions and salary estimates
- **Interview experiences** — Questions, difficulty, outcomes
- **Pay-per-result pricing** — No monthly subscription, only pay for what you scrape
- **Ultra-efficient** — Go/TLS, ~12MB Docker image, 128MB memory

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/glassdoor-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `glassdoor-scraper` to scrape company data from glassdoor. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Scraping Modes

| Mode | Description | Output |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `reviews` | Company reviews with ratings | Title, pros, cons, rating, job title, date |
| `jobs` | Open positions | Title, location, salary estimate, description |
| `salaries` | Salary data by role | Job title, base pay, total pay, count |
| `interviews` | Interview experiences | Questions, difficulty, outcome, process |
| `overview` | Company overview | Rating, size, industry, CEO, headquarters |
| `benefits` | Employee benefits | Benefit name, rating, description |

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Default |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `startUrls` | string[] | Glassdoor company URLs | Required |
| `mode` | enum | Scraping mode (see table above) | "reviews" |
| `maxResults` | number | Maximum results per company | 50 |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Proxy settings (residential recommended) | Auto |

## Output Example (Reviews Mode)

```json
{
  "company_name": "SAP",
  "company_logo_url": "https://media.glassdoor.com/sql/...",
  "review_title": "Great work-life balance",
  "rating": 4,
  "pros": "Flexible hours, good benefits, international teams",
  "cons": "Slow decision making, bureaucracy",
  "job_title": "Software Engineer",
  "employment_status": "Current Employee",
  "review_date": "2026-03-15",
  "recommend": true,
  "ceo_approval": true,
  "source_platform": "glassdoor.com"
}
```

## Pricing

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start | $0.005 |
| Result scraped (review/job/salary) | $0.003 |
| Company overview extracted | $0.005 |

## Supported URL Formats

- Reviews: `glassdoor.com/Reviews/{Company}-Reviews-E{id}.htm`
- Jobs: `glassdoor.com/Jobs/{Company}-Jobs-E{id}.htm`
- Salaries: `glassdoor.com/Salary/{Company}-Salaries-E{id}.htm`
- Interviews: `glassdoor.com/Interview/{Company}-Interview-Questions-E{id}.htm`
- Overview: `glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-{Company}-EI_IE{id}.htm`
